desc: Define DP state and transitions (suffix DP g[i][c][ℓ] chosen over forward dp; O(1) amortized transitions via closeBest per position)
Design lexicographic tie-break: forward greedy reconstruction using exact suffix costs (replaces parent-pointer/tuple approaches)
Impossibility handling: n<3 → "" (also surfaced as INF by DP)

Implement `minCostGoodCaption`: early return "" for n<3; precompute orig ints; build suffix DP table g (rows i=n..0, array('i') length 78, index c*3+(ℓ-1), INF=10**9 capped); compute optimum V = min_c cost0(c)+g[1][c][0]; greedy lexicographic reconstruction walking forward trying 'a'..'z'; return built string or "" if V is INF.

Test against examples ("cdcd"→"cccc", "aca"→"aaa", "bc"→"") plus edge cases: n=3 ("abc"), n=4/5 (single run only), n=7 (3+4 split vs single run), all-same-char string, and brute-force verify tiny random strings against exhaustive search over good target strings — all pass, zero mismatches.
Verify performance and memory for n=5×10⁴ (~0.35s runtime, ~16MB table via array('i')).
